verdict.rationale: Getting-started docs give a recurring-schedule example: "Check the connected planning channel each weekday at 9 AM Central for the next four weeks." The controls docs separately refer to "future scheduled runs" that Pause does not cancel, which confirms recurring scheduled jobs are a first-party capability of the always-on cloud dot. The evidence is thin, though: scheduling appears only through a natural-language example and a passing mention in the controls page. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on creating, listing, editing and cancelling schedules; detail on supported recurrence patterns; independent or hands-on corroboration.
